schemaNote: corePolicy = what the LA SAYS it does. lawfulnessFlag = whether that survives scrutiny.
publishableNote: [HARD R9] An entry may only be used in a user-facing calculation or page when publishable === true, which requires a non-empty, dated policySourceUrl (and, where a lawfulnessFlag is present, a non-empty sourceUrl and decisionDate). CI enforces this. Entries below are seeded from research but their URLs have not been re-sourced, so all are publishable: false and the engine ignores them, falling back to national minimums plus the COUNCIL_POLICY_UNKNOWN flag. See spec §42 item 5.

authorities.name: Devon County Council

lawfulnessFlag.summary: LGSCO 2024: blanket Child Benefit deduction from carers on means-tested benefits found unlawful. Recalculation and refunds ordered for approx. 170 carers, plus £300 + £300 remedy payments.
